title: Siftly Alternatives for Tracking AI Visibility in 2026
summary: Your brand gets praised all day in ChatGPT and Perplexity, until it doesn't. One model update, one new competitor content push
body_markdown:
## Introduction


Your brand gets praised all day in ChatGPT and Perplexity, until it doesn't. One model update, one new competitor content push, and suddenly a rival occupies the citation spot your team earned six months ago. You cannot spot that shift by staring at Google rank trackers. AI search engines don't index content, they extract it, and the outputs shift probabilistically with every model release. That churn has created an acute need: tools built purely to monitor brand presence inside generative answers.


[Siftly](https://siftly.ai/ai-instructions) entered this space early with a free audit and multi-engine tracking across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini,[and Google AI Overviews](https://llmpulse.ai/blog/best-siftly-alternatives/) . It built a GEO platform that links visibility data to prescriptive optimization, connecting brand monitoring to conversion events from AI-referred clicks. For many teams, that is the right starting point.


But accelerating adoption means the market of AIops alternatives has expanded fast. Multiple AI surfaces now influence buyers daily, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Google AI Overviews. Platforms are differentiating on engine breadth, citation depth, and pricing model. What worked six months ago may underserve you now. This piece maps the strongest Siftly alternatives across those decision dimensions, grounded in current pricing, engine coverage, and capability data for 2026.


## Key Takeaways


Selection criteria for AI visibility tools in 2026 cluster around five dimensions. Here is where the leading alternatives stand apart:


- **LLM Pulse is the closest feature-match to Siftly:** starting at €49/month with five standard AI engines, citation tracking, share-of-voice, and a native Looker Studio connector included from the entry plan.
- **Otterly.AI is the budget experimentation pick at $29/month:** it offers multi-model trial capability but a narrower feature set that favors initial testing over ongoing production monitoring.
- **RankScale leads on engine breadth with 17+ AI engines monitored from a single credit pool:** entry starts at $99/month, positioning it for teams that prioritize coverage volume above all else.
- **Semrush and SE Ranking have added AI modules at $99/month per domain (or 200 prompt bundle):** they suit teams already committed to those stacks but introduce separate line items for generative tracking.
- **Free audits differ in depth:** Siftly's AI Visibility Checker runs without sign-up and pulls citations from ChatGPT and Claude across real buyer questions, while LLM Pulse offers self-serve add-ons for engines beyond its default five.

## Comparison Table: Siftly vs. Top AI Visibility Tracking Alternatives


Pricing, engine coverage, and citation capability vary enough that a side-by-side view is the fastest way to filter. Note: pricing reflects the most accessible plan available at publication for each platform.


- **Starting price:** Siftly has a $0/month Free plan while[LLM Pulse starts at](https://llmpulse.ai/blog/best-siftly-alternatives/) €49/month and Otterly.AI enters the market at $29/month.
- **Engine coverage range:** RankScale monitors 17+ AI engines on a shared credit pool, and Peec AI is built for multilingual European surfaces.
- **Citation depth:** LLM Pulse includes share-of-voice and a native Looker Studio connector at entry, while Otterly.AI positions as a lighter trial tool with fewer analytical layers.
- **Brand-level insight:** Profound offers branded reporting dashboards suited to high-touch agency presentations and premium analytics outputs.
- **Free trial terms:** Siftly provides a free audit with no sign-up required; LLM Pulse includes self-serve add-ons at the entry tier for engines beyond its five standard surfaces.


## Siftly


Siftly is a GEO platform with four distinguishing characteristics:


- **Core measurement focus:** It was not built as an SEO tool with an AI module attached; measurement sits at the core.
- **Broad detection scope:** The platform detects how probabilistic generation models cite, describe, and rank brands across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini,[and Google AI Overviews](https://llmpulse.ai/blog/best-siftly-alternatives/) .
- **Dual product lines:** Siftly Answers covers general brand visibility (mention rates, citation quality, sentiment, positioning), while Siftly Shopping tracks visibility at the product and SKU level by connecting a Shopify store (multi-geography coverage requires Enterprise on both lines).
- **Low-friction on-ramp:** Users run the free AI Visibility Checker with no sign-up and no calls to non-public endpoints; paid plans add daily visibility, rank, and share-of-voice measurement, competitive benchmarking across AI engines, and prescriptive content fixes.

LLM Pulse suits teams that want production-grade citation depth, share-of-voice metrics, and a direct Looker Studio feed from day one, without scaling to a wider engine set. That makes it a strong option for Siftly users evaluating feature parity at a comparable price tier.


## Otterly.AI


Otterly.AI starts where many teams begin: with a $29/month entry point and multi-model tracking that covers enough ground to validate whether AI visibility even matters for the business. That is a real advantage for brands still deciding if they need a full GEO platform at all.


The trade-off is scope. Otterly.AI tracks several models, but it does not include the competitor benchmarking depth, share-of-voice scoring, or broad integrations you get from LLM Pulse or Siftly. For marketing teams that only need a weekly directional check, that may be enough.


Think of it as the exploratory tier. A team can test AI citation tracking for a few months at minimal cost, find out whether ChatGPT or Perplexity surfaces them anywhere, and then decide whether to step up to a platform built for continuous monitoring. Otterly.AI fits that handoff cleanly, but it will frustrate anyone who needs daily visibility checks, detailed competitive positioning data, or attribution tied to AI-referred traffic.


## RankScale


RankScale tracks 17+ AI engines from a single credit pool, offering the widest surface coverage in this comparison with several key traits:


- **Credit-pool pricing:** The $99/month entry plan runs on shared credits; every query pulls from the same pot, so teams can shift tracking volume toward whichever surfaces matter that week.
- **Cost escalation risk:** Costs jump fast when monitoring needs grow, a team running the same 50 prompts across 17 models daily will drain an entry-tier credit allocation before the month is half over.
- **Best-fit users:** RankScale clicks for organizations that already have a clear query priority list and a defined set of high-value AI surfaces; it rewards active credit management and punishes the set-it-and-forget-it approach.
- **Alternative for predictable budgets:** For teams that need daily monitoring on a flat, predictable budget across a smaller set of core engines, LLM Pulse or Siftly are the cleaner fit, but when breadth is the non-negotiable item, RankScale owns that corner.


## Peec AI


Peec AI tracks AI visibility across several European languages in a single dashboard. Most platforms in this comparison build for English first. If your campaigns run in German, French, or Spanish, that English-first assumption creates blind spots. Peec AI fills those gaps by monitoring how local-language models cite your brand.


A US team running English-only monitoring gets more mileage from any of the wider-coverage tools on this list. Switching to Peec AI adds complexity without much upside. The logic flips for a European marketing team. When product visibility depends on showing up in French and German model outputs, multilingual tracking is not optional. Peec AI handles that directly while the broader platforms treat it as an afterthought.


## Profound


Profound approaches AI visibility from a different angle. The platform focuses on branded reporting and premium analytics, not raw citation counts. Its core investment is the presentation layer: custom dashboards, branded client reports, and analytics outputs designed for agency and in-house brand teams that need to socialize AI visibility results upward.


The tool is built for teams that already know they need AI visibility data but care more about how that data gets packaged, shared, and acted on. The trade-off is that Profound's citation measurement infrastructure gets less attention in available research than its reporting layer. For teams that prioritize measurement depth first, LLM Pulse or Siftly remain stronger starting points.


When executive-ready narrative and visual storytelling around AI brand presence matter as much as the underlying data, Profound fills that gap. Comparative research reveals little detail on Profound's engine coverage breadth, entry pricing, and integration surface. The platform appears built for practitioners who value analytics sophistication over transparent, side-by-side spec comparison.


## Which Should You Choose?


Map your scenario to the platform rather than chasing the tool with the best spec sheet. A solo operator testing whether AI visibility exists at all needs something fundamentally different from an agency tracking 15 clients across six AI surfaces.


For operators starting from zero, Otterly.AI's $29/month entry provides the lowest-risk test environment. Run queries across multiple models for a quarter, benchmark the results, and only invest in a deeper platform if the data justifies it. You can use a tool like Siftly's free AI Visibility Checker alongside it, no sign-up required, to get a second read on your ChatGPT and Claude presence at no cost.


Teams already paying for Semrush or SE Ranking face a bundling decision. Semrush's AI module runs[$99/month per domain](https://siftly.ai/blog/semrush-alternatives) ; SE Ranking offers standalone AI tracking at $99/month for 200 prompts across 5 engines. Those numbers can work for a single brand already inside the suite. But once you add multiple domains or need daily monitoring frequency, a pure-play GEO platform like LLM Pulse often costs less while providing deeper AI-specific analytics. The bundled path trades depth for convenience; pure-play tools trade integration for capability.


## Conclusion


Pick a platform on engine coverage, then on whether you need citation measurement or a general pulse check. Skip the feature grids for ten minutes.


LLM Pulse and Siftly are the two that compete hardest on depth. RankScale gives you the widest set of AI surfaces. If the price makes you flinch, Otterly.AI starts at $29/month and still covers the engines most teams care about.


European firms publishing in German, French, or Spanish tend to land on Peec AI. Buyers who want clean dashboards over raw data often end up with Profound. And if your stack already runs on Semrush or SE Ranking, the AI tracking modules inside those suites are good enough to avoid adding a new line item.


Start with what you actually need. Run your top 50 queries through two tools on a trial week, compare the coverage gaps, then sign up for the one that shows you the data you were blind to before. The market has split cleanly enough that engine reach, citation depth, and refresh cadence do most of the sorting for you.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### What are the leading alternatives to Siftly for tracking AI visibility and generative engine optimization?


Several alternatives fill different niches in the GEO platform landscape:


- **LLM Pulse:** Closest direct alternative with five-engine monitoring, citation tracking, and share-of-voice starting at €49/month.
- **RankScale:** Widest coverage at 17+ engines from $99/month.
- **Otterly.AI:** Budget entry starting at $29/month.
- **Peec AI and Profound:** Fill multilingual and branded-reporting niches respectively.


### How do Siftly alternatives compare in terms of features like AI citation tracking, competitor benchmarking, and multi-engine monitoring?


Here is how the key platforms compare on specific features:


- **LLM Pulse:** Matches Siftly on citation tracking, share-of-voice, and competitive benchmarking with a native Looker Studio connector.
- **RankScale:** Adds sentiment tracking across 17+ engines on a credit-pool model.
- **Otterly.AI:** Offers multi-model tracking but with less analytical depth, a trial-friendly option rather than a production monitoring platform.


### Which AI visibility tracking platforms offer free tools or audits similar to Siftly's AI Visibility Checker?


Siftly's AI Visibility Checker runs without sign-up, queries ChatGPT and Claude with buyer questions, and shows competitor citations. LLM Pulse offers self-serve trials. CapstonAI provides a free scan at app.capston.ai/audit[that runs category prompts across major engines](https://capston.ai/ai-seo-tools) and identifies where a brand appears and who is cited instead.


### What should I look for when choosing a platform for monitoring brand presence in AI-powered search engines?


Prioritize AI engine coverage on the entry plan: at minimum ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode, and Google AI Overviews. Then evaluate transparent cost-per-prompt pricing, citation depth, sentiment, share-of-voice, competitor benchmarking, and integration fit with your existing analytics stack. Daily monitoring frequency often separates production tools from trial-oriented platforms.


### Are there any platforms that combine traditional SEO tracking with generative AI visibility metrics?


Semrush added an AI module at $99/month per domain, and SE Ranking offers standalone AI tracking at $99/month for 200 prompts across five engines. Both sit inside traditional SEO suites and reduce vendor count for teams already committed to those platforms. The trade-off is that AI-specific depth tends to be shallower than in dedicated GEO tools like LLM Pulse or Siftly.
